basic_details.job_title: PAU Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for Senior Field / Lab Helper Posts
basic_details.short_information: The Department of Entomology, Punjab Agricultural University (PAU), Ludhiana has invited applications for the contractual post of Senior Field / Lab Helper at Rs 15,414/- (additional Rs. 800/-) per month (fixed). The completed application, attested copies of testimonials and the Rs 100/- fee payment receipt go to the Head, Department of Entomology, PAU, Ludhiana, on or before 9 December 2026. Selected applicants appear before the Selection Committee on 17 December 2026 at 11.30 A.M.

qualification.details: The posts are filled on a contractual basis. The qualification has two alternatives: | 10+2 with Punjabi up to Matric level, with four years' experience as Jr. Field / Lab Coordinator / Junior Field / Lab Helper; OR Matric with Punjabi, with eight years' experience as Jr. Field / Lab. Coordinator / Junior Field Lab Helper. Age: 18 years to 50 years. The notice prints no cut-off date for age and lists no age relaxation. Desirable: preference will be given to candidates already assisting in the conduct of field experiments or handling of samples or laboratory analysis. | Reservation: 25% and 12% of the posts are reserved for candidates belonging to scheduled caste / tribes and backward classes belonging to Punjab State, respectively. 13% of the posts are reserved for Ex-serviceman and 3% for physically handicapped persons.

selection_process: Applicants appear before the Selection Committee for screening of the original documents on 17.12.2026 at 11.30 A.M. in the office of the Head
Department of Entomology. The notice describes no written test or other stage. No separate letter will be issued for this appearance.
important_instructions: No TA/DA will be given to the applicants. The services of the incumbent(s) are liable to be terminated at any time without any notice. The fee is Rs 100/-, paid through online mode in favour of Comptroller, PAU recruitment (Saving Account No. 29380100017259). Applications must be complete in all respect and come with attested copies of the testimonials.

content_sections.heading: About PAU
content_sections.text: Punjab Agricultural University (PAU) is based in Ludhiana, Punjab. This notice is issued by the Head of its Department of Entomology and is addressed to all Deans, Directors, other Officers and Heads of Departments of PAU, and to all Directors of outside Regional Stations, Sub Stations and KVKs of the University.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Send the application form, complete in all respect, to the Head, Department of Entomology, PAU, Ludhiana. The notice does not print a PIN code or a postal mode. The form can be downloaded from the Recruitments page of the PAU website, where the post is listed with the "Click here to download form" link. Enclose attested copies of the testimonials. Pay Rs 100/- through online mode in favour of Comptroller, PAU recruitment (Saving Account No. 29380100017259). Deposit the payment receipt with the Department of Entomology office on or before 09.12.2026. The notice carries Memo No. Ent.A-I-2026/7453-502, dated Ludhiana, 25.11.2026.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: The posts are filled on a contractual basis. The qualification has two alternatives: 10+2 with Punjabi up to Matric level, with four years' experience as Jr. Field / Lab Coordinator / Junior Field / Lab Helper; OR Matric with Punjabi, with eight years' experience as Jr. Field / Lab. Coordinator / Junior Field Lab Helper. Age: 18 years to 50 years. The notice prints no cut-off date for age and lists no age relaxation. Desirable: preference will be given to candidates already assisting in the conduct of field experiments or handling of samples or laboratory analysis. Reservation: 25% and 12% of the posts are reserved for candidates belonging to scheduled caste / tribes and backward classes belonging to Punjab State, respectively. 13% of the posts are reserved for Ex-serviceman and 3% for physically handicapped persons.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Application form complete in all respect. Attested copies of the testimonials. Payment receipt of the Rs 100/- fee, to be deposited with the Department of Entomology office. Original documents, which are screened by the Selection Committee on 17.12.2026.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Applicants appear before the Selection Committee for screening of the original documents on 17.12.2026 at 11.30 A.M. in the office of the Head, Department of Entomology. The notice describes no written test or other stage. No separate letter will be issued for this appearance.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the PAU Senior Field / Lab Helper post?
faq.answer: The application, with the Rs 100/- fee payment receipt deposited with the Department of Entomology office, is due on or before 9 December 2026 (09.12.2026).

faq.question: Q2. What is the qualification for Senior Field / Lab Helper at PAU?
faq.answer: 10+2 with Punjabi up to Matric level and four years' experience as Jr. Field / Lab Coordinator / Junior Field / Lab Helper, OR Matric with Punjabi and eight years' experience in the same role.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the PAU Senior Field / Lab Helper post?
faq.answer: The age limit is 18 years to 50 years. The notice prints no cut-off date for age.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary of the PAU Senior Field / Lab Helper?
faq.answer: The pay is Rs 15,414/- (additional Rs. 800/-) per month (fixed).

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for the PAU Senior Field / Lab Helper post?
faq.answer: The fee is Rs 100/-, paid through online mode in favour of Comptroller, PAU recruitment (Saving Account No. 29380100017259). The payment receipt is deposited with the Department of Entomology office.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for the PAU Senior Field / Lab Helper post?
faq.answer: Send the completed application form with attested copies of the testimonials to the Head, Department of Entomology, PAU, Ludhiana, and deposit the fee receipt with the same office by 09.12.2026.

faq.question: Q7. How are applicants selected for the PAU Senior Field / Lab Helper post?
faq.answer: Applicants appear before the Selection Committee for screening of original documents on 17.12.2026 at 11.30 A.M. in the office of the Head, Department of Entomology.

faq.question: Q8. Is the PAU Senior Field / Lab Helper post permanent?
faq.answer: No, the notice invites applications on a contractual basis, and the services of the incumbent(s) are liable to be terminated at any time without any notice.

faq.question: Q9. Will PAU pay travel allowance for the Selection Committee appearance?
faq.answer: No, the notice states that no TA/DA will be given to the applicants, and that no separate letter will be issued for the appearance.

faq.question: Q10. Are any PAU Senior Field / Lab Helper posts reserved?
faq.answer: Yes. 25% and 12% of the posts are reserved for scheduled caste / tribes and backward classes belonging to Punjab State, respectively, 13% for Ex-serviceman and 3% for physically handicapped persons.
